Description:[Gu Qinghan was born in the imperial city of Zhongzhou in the Wuji Empire, the eldest daughter of the emperor, was named the eldest princess, and was favored by the emperor. At the age of five, the emperor's uncle staged a coup and set fire to the crown prince's residence, Gu Qinghan and her mother fled to the Moon Wheel Kingdom and hid there. More than 10 years later, in order to find her missing father and sister, Gu Qinghan decides to return to the Wuji Empire to make her way through the jungles and the lakes."]
